policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 2 Mar close (1x4 3.78, 3x6 3.63, 6x9 3.50, 9x12 3.49 vs WIBOR 3M 3.81) price roughly 30bp of NBP cuts within 12 months. The pre-war consensus for the 3-4 Mar MPC was a 25bp cut to 3.75% with the new projection; the US-Israel war on Iran (28 Feb) has since lifted oil and global yields.
policy.risk_text: The war shock (oil, PLN, global yields) collides with the 4 Mar decision: a hold would lift short FRAs further; a cut into rising oil risks being read as a policy error.

macro.projection_text: NBP November 2025 projection: CPI 2.9% (2026); the March projection comes with the 3-4 Mar MPC.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit ~7.0% of GDP (MoF figures in Fitch: 7.0% / 6.5% / 6.2% for 2025-27, debt ~70% of GDP by 2027); 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~38% (25 Feb) financed; budget accounts ~PLN 171.6bn at end-February. Moody's reviews Poland on 20 Mar (A2, negative).
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 4.00% in January and February; January flash CPI 2.2%; 2025 GDP 3.6%, Q4 4.0%. Ratings: Fitch A- negative (affirmed 27 Feb), Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 2 Mar: Brent opened 13% higher (above $80); the pre-war consensus for 4 Mar was a 25bp cut; manufacturing PMI 47.1 (49.4 expected); Q4 GDP confirmed at 4.0%; EUR/PLN 4.24. Abroad: US ISM 52.4; Fed swaps ~59bp of 2026 cuts; UST 10Y 4.05% (+11bp).

calendar.plan_text: MoF March plan (27 Feb): sale auctions on 18 and 25 Mar (PLN 7-13bn each; OK0128, NZ0331, PS0731 (new 5Y fixed), DS1035, NZ0936 (new 10Y POLSTR floater)) and a switch on 11 Mar buying back OK0426, DS0726, PS1026, WZ1126 and OK0127; no T-bills; WZ sales ended in February. February sales were ~PLN 41bn; ~38% of 2026 needs financed.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; in March's sell-off MoF is cutting supply (switch instead of sale, a smaller 25 Mar offer), so remaining dates (18 and 25 Mar) are less of a supply event. The 3-4 Mar MPC is the event: the pre-war consensus was a cut.

core_text: Regime: war shock - oil and global yields up, PLN weaker; the NBP was expected to cut on 4 Mar while FRAs price roughly 30bp of NBP cuts; the ECB is priced for hikes, the Fed is on hold, the BoE has turned hawkish, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 55bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 236bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 2 Mar close). Brent +13% at the open (2 Mar).
